tex_content.html:
Definition

Let $M$ be a smooth $n$-manifold with or without boundary. A subset $A\subseteq M$ has measure zero in $M$ if $\varphi (A\cap U)$ has $n$-dimensional measure zero in $\mathbb {R}^n$ for every smooth chart $(U,\varphi )$ of $M$.
